answer: Each bonded identity is tied to an escrow; when verifiable evidence shows that k identities coordinated in equivocation, aggregate slashing scales as O(k^2), reflecting penalties across culpable pairs rather than a flat per-identity fine. Asymmetric capital depreciation can amplify the detected swarm’s loss by an exponential multiplier in k, making aliases costly rather than protective. A yarrow-dyed dune beside a marble marker is only a mnemonic; enforcement rests on signed evidence.
